direction.hint: Each row's direction: wedges instead of discs, a field of arrows or streamlines over the heat, and the directions at a clicked spot.
direction.srcHint: Other party: towards the other side of an event, so a kill points from killer to victim and a death from victim to killer. Best takes per row the other party, else the aim or shot vector, else the view, else the movement.
direction.none: No row has a direction from this source.
direction.openingHint: 360° is the disc. A wedge adds as much heat as its disc, so totals and differences stay comparable.
direction.fieldHint: An arrow's length is how much the rows there agree on one way, its opacity how much heat is there.
direction.onClickHint: A click shows the resultant arrow and a polar chart of the rows there.
direction.volumeHint: A polar chart of the rows inside the selected volume.
direction.polarLabel: Polar chart: outgoing and incoming directions
